entry_route.value: Students may enter the PhD with a bachelor's degree (minimum 90 credit hours) or a master's degree (minimum 60 credit hours).
entry_route.quote: The student must complete a minimum of 90 credit hours of graduate work beyond the bachelor’s degree, or a minimum of 60 credit hours of graduate work beyond the master’s degree, including in either case at least 30 credit hours of research.
